delete.description: Deletes the subscription AND tears down its enrollment identity: the automation row (when no sibling repo shares it), its expiring repo grant, and its Buildkite OIDC binding. The Buildkite pipeline itself is always kept. Pass keep_identity=true to delete only the subscription — for an immediate re-enroll that must preserve automation_id, since teardown retires it and a re-enroll declares a new one that only bk_force_rescaffold pushes into the pipeline. A retained identity holds read access on this repo until its grant lapses. A subscription enrolled before the automation principal has no automation to retire: the delete succeeds and removes only the subscription, reported as identity_retired=false on the ci_webhook_deleted audit event — the list an operator queries to hand-delete the leftover service accounts.
